paragraphs.text: Choose the language used for DSH reasoning and expand thinking rows by default.
# dsh-reasoning-language
简体中文

Ask DeepSeek Harness to use a chosen reasoning language (Simplified Chinese by default), and
expand

thinking rows while preserving rows the reader manually collapses. The language is a
system-prompt r
equest; model compliance is not guaranteed. Final replies follow the user's language.
## Compatibility

Version **0.2.0** targets the DSH 0.2 configuration API. Verified against published DSH
`0.2.0-rc.2`

(latest) and `0.2.1-rc.2` (next), as of 2026-10-18. Requires Node
`^22.19.0 || >=24`, Cordis `>=4.0

.4`, and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery >=3.18.4`.
DSH 0.1 users should keep plugin 0.1.0. Future DSH pre
release tuples require explicit verification.
## Install or upgrade
Install the prebuilt release into your active profile (replace `web` if needed):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Alternatively install the tagged JavaScript sources:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

These commands also replace an existing installation of the same package. Restart DSH after
installa

tion, then reload the browser. No build script or npm account is needed. The package is
distributed
through GitHub Releases, not currently through npm.
## Settings
Open Settings → **Thinking language**. The page provides:
| Setting | Default | Behavior |

| Enabled | On | Request the chosen reasoning language during subsequent prompt assemblies. |
| Thin
king language | 简体中文 | Any language name; whitespace is trimmed and input limited to 80 characters.

|
| Expand thinking rows | On | Expand streamed and existing thinking rows after the Host accepts th
hinking rows | On | Expand streamed and existing thinking rows after the Host accepts the setting. |

Changes persist in the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, under the Loader entry id
`dsh-reasoning

-language`. Model-language changes apply at the next prompt assembly; existing text
is never transla

ted or rewritten. The final-answer language is not overridden. Code, paths,
commands, error text, UR
Ls and proper nouns are explicitly excluded from translation.

DSH 0.2 removed `settings.register()` and browser `settingsScope`. This version exports a plugin
`Co

nfig` with volatile fields and uses `configForms.get('dsh-reasoning-language')`. Refused writes
show
an error; the expander changes only after accepted state reaches the shared form.
### Migrating 0.1.0 preferences

DSH 0.2 may have moved the old `settings.yaml` to `settings.yaml.imported`. The former namespace
`re

asoning-language` differs from the plugin's Loader entry id, so those preferences are not
automatica

lly restored by this plugin. Re-enter them in the settings page, or copy the three
values into the e
xisting profile patch entry:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use the profile's existing entry if present. Avoid composing two copies of this plugin.
## Disable, remove and rollback

The Enabled switch controls language injection; the expansion switch is independent. Turn both
off t
o disable both behaviors. Removing the package:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH after removal. To roll back, install the previous Git commit together with a compatible
DSH 0.1 runtime: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:jide315/dsh-reasoning-language#c2273c8`.
## Development and verification
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The integration suites boot a real DSH Loader with SettingsForms, ConfigEditor and SystemPrompt,
and

exercise the published browser ConfigForms with real React and DOM events. They cover live
edits, p

ersistence/restart, revision conflicts, reset, rejected writes and user disclosure choices.
CI runs
both supported DSH versions under Node 22 and 24.
The disclosure behavior uses `[data-variant="think"]` and `[data-disclosure-row]`, verified against

the current upstream components. Changes to those DOM markers require an update. This plugin
does no

t make network requests of its own, read credentials, or rewrite conversation history.
Settings use
DSH's existing configuration transport. Report bugs through this repository's Issues.
